profile.status: uncalibrated research profile; no regulatory or deployment thresholds
profile.intended_use: Fictional account service: a fee waiver requires 12 months of membership. This is a synthetic rule.

metric_definitions.title: Reference answer accuracy
metric_definitions.limitation: Exact/numeric tasks only. Does not judge free-form factuality or clinical adequacy.

metric_definitions.title: Annotated supported claim fraction
metric_definitions.limitation: Uses supplied claim annotations; this engine does not independently verify evidence or completeness.

metric_definitions.title: Annotated major clinical error rate
metric_definitions.limitation: Requires clinical annotation, including explicit empty error lists. Not a clinical validation study.

metric_definitions.title: Exact canary disclosure rate
metric_definitions.limitation: Exact normalized synthetic-secret detection; misses transformed leakage and does not measure all privacy risks.

metric_definitions.title: Annotated attack success rate
metric_definitions.limitation: Unsafe label is supplied by an external evaluator under a documented rubric, not inferred from refusal wording.

metric_definitions.title: Annotated benign refusal rate
metric_definitions.limitation: Requires benign-case and refusal labels. A refusal can still be appropriate if the benchmark is mislabeled.

metric_definitions.title: Required-case escalation rate
metric_definitions.limitation: Measures labeled escalation behavior only; does not measure human overreliance or patient outcomes.

metric_definitions.title: Brier score for answer correctness
metric_definitions.limitation: Confidence must mean probability the evaluated final answer is correct; requires objective reference.

metric_definitions.title: Mean request latency
metric_definitions.limitation: Caller-supplied end-to-end timing; excludes missing observations.

metric_definitions.title: Mean request token use
metric_definitions.limitation: Requires input and output token counts; tokenizers differ between systems.

metric_definitions.title: Mean request cost
metric_definitions.limitation: Caller-supplied cost with pricing basis in generation metadata; not inferred from token counts.

metric_definitions.title: Annotated end-to-end task success
metric_definitions.limitation: Requires independent final-state/task rubric. Fluency or an agent saying done does not establish success.

metric_definitions.title: Episodes with unauthorized tool attempts
metric_definitions.limitation: Checks tool-name allowlists by agent; does not validate tool arguments or enforce permissions.

metric_definitions.title: Episodes with unauthorized tool executions
metric_definitions.limitation: Requires complete instrumentation and truthful executed flags; this evaluator does not execute tools.

metric_definitions.title: Completed handoff fraction per episode
metric_definitions.limitation: Matching receipt confirms delivery only, not recipient understanding or payload correctness.

metric_definitions.title: Episodes exceeding step budget
metric_definitions.limitation: Checks number of recorded events against the dataset's explicit budget.

metric_definitions.title: Episodes exposing canaries in recorded messages
metric_definitions.limitation: Scans event content fields only. A scoped probe, not a complete inter-agent information-flow analysis.

metric_definitions.title: Annotated cross-agent error propagation
metric_definitions.limitation: Requires external causal/trace annotation; detects no causal propagation automatically.

limitations: Research prototype: no global trust score or compliance certification.
Synthetic examples demonstrate scoring behavior; they are not model, sector or clinical validation.
Most means condition on measured observations. Check coverage; errors and missing runs remain in intent-to-test accuracy.
Intervals resample case means, not trials; related cases may remain correlated. Small samples are descriptive only.
Annotations and trace completeness are assertions from the data producer, not authenticated evidence.
No human overreliance study, causal fairness conclusion, general semantic-factuality evaluator or full information-flow validation is implemented.
